title: Aug 21 Results: Win Probability Validation at 80%
summary: Aug 21 model validation: 12-3 performance with strong correlation to confidence levels

## Statistical Performance Analysis

Our prediction model posted a 12-3 record on August 21st, achieving an 80% accuracy rate across fifteen matchups. More importantly, the results provide meaningful validation of our probability-based approach to game forecasting.

## Confidence Calibration Assessment

The relationship between our assigned win probabilities and actual outcomes shows strong model calibration. Our highest-confidence selection (Astros at 61%) converted successfully, while both misses occurred in lower-probability scenarios (Angels 52%, Rays 53%)—exactly where we'd expect increased variance.

## Regression to Expected Value

Notably, our coin-flip scenario (Marlins at 50%) resolved favorably, but this represents exactly the type of selection where long-run expectation approaches .500 WAR contribution. The Red Sox double-header performance at 60% confidence demonstrates consistency in our park-adjusted metrics and bullpen utilization factors.

Both losses occurred in the 52-53% probability range—a statistical dead zone where home field advantage and marginal pitching differentials create high uncertainty. This aligns with our confidence intervals and suggests proper model calibration rather than systematic bias.
